\textbf{Part A --- Lessons}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=*, label=\textbf{A\arabic*.}, itemsep=1pt]
    \item $k$-th smallest by value search: count how many are $\le v$
    \item The multiplication table and pair distances: counting in $\bigO{n}$ or $\bigO{n\log n}$
    \item Median of two sorted arrays by partitioning
    \item Products of two sorted arrays with negative numbers
    \item Median via $\pm 1$ transform: ``median $\ge v$'' as a prefix-sum check
